name: Gizmon: AT
main_effect:
When you would play this card from your hand, by deleting 1 of your level 3 Digimon, reduce the play cost by 4.
[On Play] ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) Then, trash 2 cards in your hand.
[All Turns] This Digimon can't digivolve.
[On Deletion] By returning 2 cards with [Gizmon] in their names from your trash to the bottom of your deck in any order, you may play 1 [Gizmon: XT] from your trash without paying its cost.
